extra.message: User input from request.GET['url'] is passed directly to urllib.request.urlopen() as the target URL. An attacker can supply internal URLs (e.g., http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/) to perform SSRF, accessing internal services or cloud metadata APIs.

extra.message: User input from request.GET['lane'] or request.POST['lane'] is passed directly to redirect() without validation. An attacker can supply an arbitrary URL (e.g., http://evil.com) to perform an open redirect, potentially used in phishing attacks.
